candidate_body_policy: Frozen build_blind_packets.clean_final; final moderator output only; evidence maps and appendices removed exactly as in prior official Pass 1 evaluations.
scoring_protocol_change: none; original public IHQ plus frozen supplementary Pass 1 are unchanged. This adapter changes candidate cardinality to one because the Q4 cases have different scientific tasks and cannot be placed in a comparative multi-candidate packet.
